marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF860B Cordless High Torque Impact Driver features a 3-Speed mode select and a 1/4-In. Hex Quick-Release Chuck, delivering a max torque of 2,500 in-lb and a no-load speed of 0-3,800 RPM. This tool is part of the MAX XR Series and is powered by a brushless motor. It has 9 built-in LEDs and is available as a tool only, with no charger or batteries included.
